changes.behavior: Reject explicit non-Automatic inference or unavailable installed components before model integrity reads. Hash eligible weights outside the configuration lock, then recheck configuration, component and busy ownership before any worker start.

public_entry_control.setup: Each run cloned the existing asset into an independent owned copy and verified its complete catalog SHA before measuring the public entry. Setup copy/hash I/O is excluded from this entry counter, not claimed zero. Both owned copies were removed after Engine/receipt release; original device/inode, size, mtime and ctime stayed unchanged on this Mac.

changes.rechecks: Three 4-byte controls preserve unlocked hashing and reject component removal, backend edits or a different busy owner after hashing. The fixture substitutes the installed-catalog reader only, not signatures, GPU compatibility or execution.

changes.behavior: After an accepted terminal watchdog yield, detach only its same-PID idle worker and reap outside locks. Recheck that Server stop reason/closing under the lease-return pool critical section; keep the stop gate through insertion, and explicitly drop guards before Child/session cleanup.
changes.scope: Real model-free child controls establish idle-slot removal, exact-PID exit confirmation and llm_pid clearing. The same session cleanup drops owned tiny admission receipts; Windows deny-write release assertions await same-source CI. Active leases keep their own cleanup; stale closing workers cannot cancel/reap newer PIDs. No epoch bump, TTL increase or scheduler change.

first_full_core.failure: Existing local HTTP download fixture read_exact returned OS35 after accepted sockets inherited nonblocking mode. Its isolated rerun passed; the original full failure is retained.

fixture_only_fix.scope: Three test-only lines clear accepted-stream nonblocking mode before the existing 2-second read timeout; no downloader product behavior change. Independent local Rust probe observed true before and false after clearing.

limits: Zero model inference calls and zero new model/component downloads in this round. Real child controls are test fixtures, not ASR/LLM runs; optional acceleration components remain external.
The measured reduction is rejected-entry weight hashing only. No end-to-end speed, GPU throughput, energy, peak-memory or VRAM-release claim; accepted SIGTERM alone is not exit proof.

No native Windows/Linux GPU or installer acceptance follows from host-independent controls. Existing Scope, model/runtime/driver identity and cancellation gates remain; Q9/Q16 and 0.3.5 release gates remain open.
